nodes.description: Owner address of the Quick ownership contract; set in constructor and changed via acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Internal mapping of account balances, mutated by _transfer and _burn.
Private nested mapping of owner=>spender=>allowance, mutated by _approve.
Internal total token supply, reduced by _burn and constrained relative to MinSupply.
Minimum supply floor (10 ether) below which burning is disallowed.
Running total of tokens burnt, incremented in burn and transfer.
Deadline timestamp (first transfer time + 20 minutes) gating the anti-whale window.
Flag marking whether the first transfer (and thus firstBlock init) has occurred.
Admin address exempted from the initial buy/hold limits.
onlyOwner function that sets the pending newOwner address.
Two-step ownership acceptance requiring msg.sender == newOwner; updates owner and clears newOwner.
Internal balance-moving routine with zero-address checks.
Internal burn routine subtracting value from supply and balance, guarded by MinSupply.
Internal transferFrom combining _transfer and allowance reduction.
Internal allowance setter with zero-address checks.
Public approval entrypoint delegating to _approve for msg.sender.
Public allowance increment using SafeMath.add.
Public allowance decrement using SafeMath.sub.
External burn entrypoint calling super._burn and accumulating totalBurnt.
Overridden transfer enforcing the first-20-minutes anti-whale limits and a randomized burn on every transfer.
Overridden transferFrom enforcing the anti-whale window then delegating to super._transferFrom.
Internal view returning keccak256 of block.timestamp, block.difficulty and msg.sender modulo 9.
Fallback receive() that immediately refunds msg.value to the sender via transfer.
Caller-controlled address used for access control, balances and randomness seed.
Miner-influenceable timestamp driving firstBlock window checks and the randNumber seed.
msg.sender.transfer(_amount) external ETH send in receive(); external interaction point.
Weak randomness derived from block.timestamp, block.difficulty and msg.sender; predictable/manipulable.
Address parameter of transferOwnership assigned to newOwner.
Burn amount parameter of Quicker.burn.
Recipient address parameter of Quicker.transfer.
Transfer amount parameter of Quicker.transfer, subject to burn math and limits.
Sender address parameter of Quicker.transferFrom.
Amount parameter of Quicker.transferFrom.
Local amount set from msg.value inside receive().
Random percentage returned by randNumber and used to compute the burn amount.
Computed burn amount (_amount * _rand / 100), zeroed if it would breach MinSupply.
Remaining amount forwarded to the recipient after the randomized burn.
Local holding msg.value before being refunded via msg.sender.transfer.

edges.reason: transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner, checking msg.sender against owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to authorize ownership acceptance.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
msg.sender balances and admin exemption are used inside Quicker.transfer.
block.timestamp compared against firstBlock to gate the anti-whale window in transfer.
firstBlock is the deadline value compared against block.timestamp in transfer.
transfer calls randNumber() to derive the randomized burn percentage.
block.timestamp is hashed into the randNumber randomness seed.
msg.sender is hashed into the randNumber randomness seed.
randNumber produces the weak randomness unsafe operation output.
randNumber return value is assigned to local _rand.
_rand is multiplied into _amount to compute _amountToBurn (mul/div via SafeMath).
_amount is scaled by _rand/100 to derive _amountToBurn.
_unBurntToken = _amount - _amountToBurn computed from the burn amount.
transfer invokes the internal _burn for the randomized amount.
transfer invokes super._transfer for the unburnt remainder.
_burn subtracts value from _totalSupply under SafeMath.sub.
_burn requires _totalSupply.sub(value) > MinSupply before burning.
_burn subtracts value from the account balance in _balances.
_transfer moves amounts between entries of _balances using SafeMath.
Quicker.burn delegates to super._burn(msg.sender, _amount).
Quicker.burn burns from the msg.sender balance.
_amount parameter drives the burn in Quicker.burn.
burn adds _amount to totalBurnt via SafeMath.add.
transferFrom compares block.timestamp against firstBlock for the anti-whale window.
msg.sender is checked against AdminAddress in transferFrom.
Quicker.transferFrom delegates to super._transferFrom.
_transferFrom calls _transfer to move balances.
_transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the allowance.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance adds to msg.sender allowance via SafeMath.add.
decreaseAllowance subtracts from msg.sender allowance via SafeMath.sub.
receive() uses msg.sender address for the refund and msg.value.
receive() assigns msg.value to local _amount.
local _amount is forwarded through msg.sender.transfer external call.
receive() performs an external ETH send to msg.sender, the reentrancy interaction point.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is only used to set the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership, so it collapses into that function.
the burn _amount parameter has no independent behavior and folds into Quicker.burn.
_recipient is only consumed by the transfer routine, so it merges into Quicker.transfer.
the transfer _amount parameter drives burn math and limits only within Quicker.transfer.
_sender is only used by the transferFrom flow and merges into that function.
the transferFrom _amount parameter has no independent semantics outside the function.
the receive amount parameter feeds directly into the msg.sender.transfer unsafe operation.
_rand is the direct return value of randNumber and merges into that function.
_amountToBurn is a transient computation inside Quicker.transfer and folds into it.
_unBurntToken is a transient remainder passed to _transfer inside Quicker.transfer.
the local _amount holds msg.value immediately before the unsafe external send.
